title: Network Engineer
description_preview:
About The Company
Bowhead / UIC Technical Services is a leading provider of specialized technical solutions and support services to government agencies and commercial clients. With a strong commitment to innovation, excellence, and integrity, the company delivers comprehensive technical expertise across various domains, including network infrastructure, system architecture, and cybersecurity. Bowhead / UIC Technical Services prides itself on fostering a collaborative work environment that encourages continuous learning and professional development, ensuring that its team members remain at the forefront of technological advancements. The organization’s mission is to support national security and operational excellence through cutting-edge technology and dedicated service.
About The Role
We are seeking a skilled Network Infrastructure Engineer to join our team in Dahlgren, VA. The successful candidate will be responsible for the operation, maintenance, and support of the CIAT system's underlying infrastructure. This role requires a deep understanding of virtualization technologies, scripting, operating systems, and complex system architectures. The engineer will play a vital role in troubleshooting issues, documenting procedures, and collaborating with team members to ensure the infrastructure’s stability, security, and optimal performance. The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem-solver with a passion for technology, a strong work ethic, and a commitment to delivering high-quality technical support in a dynamic environment.
Qualifications
The ideal candidate will possess three to five years of experience in networking, IT, or related fields, with a strong educational background including a bachelor’s degree. Preferred certifications include CompTIA Security+ CE and VMware or IaaS certifications. Candidates should demonstrate proficiency in virtualization platforms such as VMware, scripting languages like PowerShell, Ansible, Bash, and Python, and possess extensive knowledge of Linux (RHEL and Ubuntu) and Windows operating systems. Additional skills in AWS environments, programming, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and system architecture are highly desirable. The candidate must hold a security clearance at the Secret level and be a U.S. citizen, with the ability to travel less than 10% for deployment and maintenance activities.
Responsibilities
The Network Infrastructure Engineer will be responsible for maintaining and troubleshooting the CIAT system’s virtualized environment using VMware, ensuring high performance and optimal resource utilization. The role involves configuring and managing virtual machines, automating administrative tasks through scripting languages, and developing comprehensive documentation for infrastructure processes and procedures. The engineer will install, configure, and maintain Linux (primarily RHEL and Ubuntu) and Windows operating systems, ensuring their security and stability. Effective communication and collaboration with team members are essential to resolve technical issues efficiently and share knowledge. The role also requires troubleshooting complex problems independently, understanding the system of systems architecture, and supporting IaaS components and interdependencies. Additional responsibilities include supporting system deployments, performing routine maintenance, and contributing to infrastructure improvements.
Benefits
Bowhead / UIC Technical Services offers a competitive salary range of $80,000 to $125,000 annually, commensurate with experience and qualifications. The company provides comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, and professional development opportunities. Employees enjoy a dynamic work environment that promotes growth, innovation, and collaboration. The organization values work-life balance and provides support for ongoing training and certifications to enhance career advancement. Additionally, the company’s commitment to national security and technological excellence offers employees the chance to contribute to meaningful and impactful projects.
Equal Opportunity
Bowhead / UIC Technical Services is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status. We believe that a diverse workforce enhances our ability to serve our clients and achieve our organizational goals. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and join our team in making a difference.

title: Domain Tech Lead — Infrastructure Patching Automation (Mainframe & AS/400)
description_preview:
Domain Tech Lead - Infrastructure Patching Automation (Mainframe & AS/400)
Join our AI & Engineering team by transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll collaborate with talented professionals, reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to business. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation and enhanced productivity.
AI & Engineering leverages innovative engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology and data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.
Recruiting for this role ends on 8/21/26.
Work you'll do
As a Domain Tech Lead on the AI & Engineering Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure team, you will own end-to-end technical delivery within a specific infrastructure domain on a large-scale infrastructure engineering engagement, with a focus on automating the patching lifecycle of multiple infrastructure areas. This is an engineering execution role - you are responsible for delivery outcomes within your domain, not just coordination across them.Our practitioners work collaboratively within integrated, cross-functional teams. You will provide hands-on technical design guidance to your engineering team, drive sprint-level delivery, and coordinate with adjacent infrastructure and engineering domains. You will be expected to solve architecture and integration problems that your engineers bring to you, and to surface domain-level risk before it becomes a program-level issue. Domain openings are available across: Database (Oracle, SQL, MongoDB, Redis, Postgres), Middleware, Cloud (AWS/Azure), Network, End User Compute, and Mainframe.
This role requires deep expertise in mainframe and AS/400 (IBM i) environments to lead and deliver the patch management program across complex legacy and hybrid infrastructure estates, develop automation solutions that reduce manual effort and risk, and serve as a trusted technical advisor to enterprise clients - working closely with client stakeholders, project managers, and cross-functional delivery teams to plan, schedule, and execute patch cycles while ensuring compliance, stability, and security across mission-critical platforms.
Own the creation and execution of a technical execution plan for your domain - maintaining delivery commitments and proactively surfacing risks
Provide hands-on technical design guidance to unblock infrastructure automation engineering: architecture decisions, integration patterns, implementation approaches
Lead detailed design and drive execution of infrastructure test harnesses, infrastructure automation engineering, and deployment capabilities within your domain
Lead technical decisions within your domain, ensuring solutions are standardized and production-scalable
Drive PI planning, backlog prioritization, and sprint-level adjustments with engineering throughput as the primary success metric
Coordinate with the Testing Platform team on infrastructure onboarding, test suite migration, and CI/CD pipeline integration
Manage cross-domain dependencies and represent your domain's delivery status to program leadership and client stakeholders
Develop junior team members through direct coaching, design reviews, and structured feedback
Patch Delivery - Mainframe & AS/400 Infrastructure
Design, plan, and execute end-to-end patch delivery program for IBM z/OS mainframe and IBM i (AS/400) environments
Manage the patch lifecycle end to end: identification, testing, scheduling, application, and post-implementation validation
Understand patch windows across development, QA, and production environments
Maintain patch compliance dashboards and KPIs
Automation Engineering - Mainframe Environments
Coordinate automation frameworks to streamline patch identification, scheduling, and deployment on z/OS and IBM i systems
Design automation pipelines with enterprise tooling (e.g., IBM Tivoli, CA7, TWS/OPC, ServiceNow, SDSF) to reduce manual touchpoints
Design automated compliance checks, health monitoring, and alert frameworks for patch-related activities
Coordinate with DevOps teams to incorporate mainframe automation into CI/CD pipelines where applicable
Client-Facing Consulting
Serve as a primary technical point of contact for client stakeholders across mainframe leadership, infrastructure, and security teams
Lead requirements-gathering workshops and translate business objectives into infrastructure delivery roadmaps
Manage client expectations and proactively communicate risks, dependencies, and change management considerations
A successful candidate would possess these skills:
Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others
The team
AI & Engineering helps organizations transform technology platforms, modernize critical operations, and drive innovation at scale. Professionals across the practice work with clients to improve performance, launch new digital capabilities, and increase productivity through engineering-led solutions.

title: Radar Engineer/Analyst (AN/TPY-2, SBX)
reason: No visa sponsorship or requires citizenship/clearance
reject_reason: No visa sponsorship or requires citizenship/clearance
description_preview:
About CFD Research:
Since its inception in 1987, CFD Research has delivered innovative technology solutions within the Aerospace & Defense, Biomedical & Life Sciences, Intelligence & Sensing, and Energy & Materials industries. CFD Research has earned multiple national awards for successful application and commercialization of innovative component/system technology prototypes, multi-physics simulation software, multi-disciplinary analyses, and expert support services. Based in Huntsville, Alabama where laboratory facilities and headquarters are located, CFD Research also has office and laboratory facilities in Dayton, Ohio, prototyping test and evaluation facilities in Hollywood, Alabama, and office facilities in Fort Walton Beach, Florida. CFD Research is an ISO9001:AS9100D registered company and is appraised at CMMI Level II for Services.
CFD Research is a 100% ESOP (employee-owned company) recognized in Inc. Magazine's Inc5000 as a top growing company for four of the last five years. Learn more at www.cfd-research.com
Job Description
CFD Research is seeking a talented Radar Analyst/Engineer to join a well-established team of analysts and software engineers that support prototyping, testing, and analysis efforts associated with tactical code development for the AN/TPY-2 and SBX radars. The candidate will work with real-time HWIL systems, tactical software & hardware of the AN/TPY-2 and SBX radars and perform prototyping, testing, analysis, and verification of tactical algorithms. Common tasks for this position include scenario design and development, analysis tool development, and application of new or existing tools to perform complex analysis on radar system performance. The candidate will enhance their understanding of critical radar functions including acquisition, tracking, discrimination, scheduling, advanced functions, and system-level interactions. The candidate may support a broad range of projects including MDA ground test performance analysis, post-flight reconstructions, and integration and risk-reduction efforts. The candidate will work in a dynamic environment that promotes team interaction, collaboration, and the development of creative solutions to challenging problems.
Basic Qualifications
Minimum of a Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Physics, or Math from an accredited institution
Mid and senior level experience candidates (2-10 years) will be considered
Proficient in data manipulation and analysis, data visualization, signal and data processing, electromagnetics, and/or system engineering
Experience leading the development of complex analysis tools using MATLAB
Ability to work effectively in team environments and independently
Good communication skills (verbal and written)
Candidate must be a U.S. Citizen and possess an Active Secret security clearance.
Desired Qualifications
Experience with radar analysis, radar systems engineering, and/or radar operations
Experience with radar signal/detection injection HWIL systems
Proficient in modeling and data analysis using Python and/or similar tools
Experience with fire control systems and simulation frameworks
Location:
This role is based at Redstone Arsenal, in the Huntsville, AL
area
,
and is 100% onsite.
Benefits:
CFD Research offers competitive salaries and excellent employee benefits, including an employer matching 401(k) and Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). CFD Research offers our Full-Time, permanent employee-owners a highly competitive insurance package, including medical, vision, and dental insurance. Additionally, we offer company paid leave, compensation time, parental leave, long-term and short-term disability, accidental death and dismemberment, and life insurance. Part-Time and Temporary employee-owners may receive partial or reduced benefits and leave time based on their employment status level. Performance appraisals occur twice a year and annual pay increases are based upon corporate goals, personal development, performance, and outstanding achievements. In addition, group and individual bonuses are awarded for exceptional performance.
CFD Research is an EO employer - Veterans/Disabled and other protected categories
